Does anyone here own a 3D printer? If so what model and what have you used it for?

Printrbot simple maker's edition. ( plywood kit, in short )
A bit too small and limited to be honest ( can only print in PLA ). But it was simpler to approach than a reprap as a first printer. ( but about the same price and with less features ). And by building it, I've learned quite a bit. Which mean that its replacement will most likely be a reprap built from cheap chinese crap and whatever material I can use for a case.

The most useful thing I used it for was to design new parts for sliding closet doors nobody could find the parts for. ( somehow the PLA parts manage to do the work of nylon ones )
Usually, I use it to print a neat model on thingiverse or learn how to push it toward what I couldn't manage before. ( and for something that literally works thanks to some strings and tubing, that's pretty impressive )
( the latest was a multi-parts octopus, which make it my first larger than build volume part. Next step is cutting down a model an then weld it back together, but I'm lazy right now )

Anyways, fun and cheap first printer, but once you know what you're doing, it end up looking like a fairly expensive and very limited printer.
( which is why most, if not all, of these printers are soon upgraded to include heat bed, and greater print size in at least the X axis )
